chunks: Everything in this book that is from ʿAmr ibn Jamīʿ, I have narrated from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from al-Ḥasan ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Luʾluʾī, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yūsuf, from Muʿādh al-Jawharī, from ʿAmr ibn Jamīʿ.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author's immediate source in this chain
key_terms.اللُّؤْلُؤِيِّ: al-Luʾluʾī; a distinctive nisbah within the chain
key_terms.الْجَوْهَرِيِّ: al-Jawharī; a distinctive nisbah within the chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement of direct reporting by the compiler
key_terms.عَمْرِو بْنِ جَمِيعٍ: the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAmr ibn Jamīʿ in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from ʿAmr ibn Jamīʿ in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission for hadith preservation and source verification.
